meta.note: Crusader Knight Rule of Life. Hidden numbers stay in the Python backend and never go on a Foundry actor. Several numeric values are flagged PLACEHOLDER where the Breath Keeper draft was truncated and had to be reconstructed from the user's summary, decisions, and the Aimery worked example.
sources: Templar Primitive Rule (Fordham, Latin Rule of 1129): https://sourcebooks.fordham.edu/source/templar-rle.asp
Hospitaller rule of Raymond du Puy

hours.note: The seven canonical Hours with the chaplain. Silence after Compline.

historical_rule.poverty_notes: No lockable purse. Owns only arms, armour, horse and habit.

campaign.note: Leaving the banner in the field is treated like murder of a Christian: expulsion, or becoming a Penitent Brother.

piety.note: C6. The Rule check replaces the generic engine decay of -4/day for anyone under the Rule. character.py still initialises piety at 0 until a value is loaded; ai_gm_engine defaults to 50. A trained brother is usually in the 50-70 band; Aimery starts at 72 as an established knight.

devotion.note: C5 anti-abuse. Confession and fasting cannot be stacked to pray a murder away. Gains never exceed the Virtue ceiling.

rule_ward.note: PLACEHOLDER reduction: incoming Veil corruption is reduced by 1 per Ward point (floor 0). Ward is hidden.

daily_cleansing.note: Decision 3. Venial stains only. Prayer never lifts a grave stain.

stain.weekly_unconfessed_note: PLACEHOLDER inferred from Aimery: +1 Corruption per open grave stain every 7 unconfessed days (three grave stains take him from 17 to 20).

penance.note: A grave stain lifts only after confession to a priest, restitution, then penance lasting `weight` days. Sins marked loss_of_the_house also require expulsion or the Penitent Brother path.

theft.note: Weight 7 is set so Aimery's three grave sins total 31 and cap Virtue at 44.

murder_christian.note: Weight 18 is needless_killing 8 plus cruelty 10, applied once so the events are not double-counted.

felt.ward_up: The lamp burns steady; the dark keeps its distance.
felt.venial_stain: The Paternosters snag on your tongue.
felt.grave_stain: You say the words. Nothing answers.
felt.vow_broken: Something that stood at your back has stepped away.
felt.confessed_unfinished: The weight has a name now. It is not gone.
felt.stain_lifted: You sleep without dreams for the first time in weeks.
felt.house_lost: The house is closed to you.

aimery.days_2_to_8: perfect Rule, confesses only to God
aimery.recovery: priest, restitution, penance, and loss of the house
